cohort: This study included 37 patients with ectopic low-lying implantation pregnancy (including cesarean scar pregnancies and cervico-isthmic pregnancies).
finding: The study found that terminating ectopic low-lying implantation pregnancy before 8 weeks gestation resulted in lower blood loss and fewer repeated invasive procedures.
gest_age: Up to 55 days (group 1) or 56 days and over (group 2)
